'''Unit 4432''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Stationed aboard [[Tambor Deep Space Centre]], it assisted [[Gorgol/Legends|Gorgol the Handy]] in defense against Republic [[Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre|siege]]. After the Republic forces seemingly broke for a run, Gorgol assigned two droid squads to investigate if their enemy was really gone. Unit 4432 led one such squad and reported the right flank to be clear, moments before being destroyed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].
